criteria.name: Design doc exists with required sections
criteria.evidence: docs/design/mcp-cards.md:5-64 contains the eight required sections: Problem statement, URI scheme, Server responsibilities, Consumption by tick.sh, Relationship to filesystem-is-the-message-bus, Multi-machine implications, Migration path, and Smallest-possible-prototype card outline.

criteria.name: Filesystem relationship has explicit conclusion
criteria.evidence: docs/design/mcp-cards.md:43-45 is a full paragraph and ends with an explicit conclusion: "Conclusion: MCP-served cards refine card delivery; the filesystem remains the message bus for everything the agents emit."

criteria.name: URI scheme is concrete
criteria.evidence: docs/design/mcp-cards.md:11-21 gives the literal scheme `stage://<repo>/<stage-id>@<version>` and a concrete example: `stage://autometta/22-mcp-served-cards-design@30faa66`.

criteria.name: Fallback to filesystem is specified
criteria.evidence: docs/design/mcp-cards.md:36-41 says resolve-card.sh reads from MCP when enabled, falls back to stage_card_for_id on unset transport or any MCP failure, and always prints a local path so tick.sh can swap one helper call and keep the rest unchanged.

criteria.name: Prototype outline is one-page sized
criteria.evidence: docs/design/mcp-cards.md:55-64 is a compact four-bullet outline with objective, deliverables, acceptance, and out-of-scope sections, short enough to lift directly into a future implementation card.

criteria.name: Decision memo format and sibling link
criteria.evidence: memory/decision-mcp-cards.md:1-24 has decision-memo frontmatter plus titled decision sections, and line 8 links to [[decision-sweep-stage]].

criteria.name: Philosophy edit stays minimal and additive
criteria.evidence: docs/philosophy.md:26-30 adds one new considered-and-deferred belief item at line 29 without rewriting existing beliefs; `git diff --numstat` shows 2 insertions and 0 deletions in docs/philosophy.md.

criteria.name: Prose stays under 1500 words
criteria.evidence: docs/design/mcp-cards.md:1-64, memory/decision-mcp-cards.md:1-24, and docs/philosophy.md:1-30 together exceed the prose budget; `wc -w` reports 2501 total words across the three deliverables, which is 1001 over the 1500-word limit.

criteria.name: No em dash or banned vocabulary
criteria.evidence: Full-text scan of docs/design/mcp-cards.md:1-64, memory/decision-mcp-cards.md:1-24, and docs/philosophy.md:1-30 found no em dash and no occurrences of delve, leverage, seamless, robust, crucial, or pivotal.

criteria.name: No code changes
criteria.evidence: `git status -s` shows only docs/philosophy.md, docs/design/mcp-cards.md, and memory/decision-mcp-cards.md changed or added; no scripts/, schemas/, or bin/autometta files are modified.

additional_findings: The prose budget is the only blocking issue. The draft is otherwise structurally aligned with the stage card.
